title: group_key_for_epoch mutates retired_epochs without lock; legacy scalar invitation burn is silent no-op
description: groups_collection.py:441,412: public group_key_for_epoch runs _live_retired(mutate=True) unlocked - can clobber retired entry appended by locked rekey (lost grace-window unprotect material). :529-532/:517-520: _consume_invitation_unlocked sets consumed=True on a synthesized throwaway dict for legacy scalar entries - burn marker silently lost (replay window persists). Lock the prune; persist normalization or refuse scalar entries.
